namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Surveyor;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * Centralized resolver for surveyor barge assignment authorization.
 *
 * - super_admin and master: unrestricted access (returns null).
 * - surveyor: returns the linked Surveyor record and assigned barge_id.
 * - No assignment: returns a denied state.
 */
class SurveyorAssignment
{
    /**
     * Resolve the authenticated user's surveyor assignment.
     *
     * @return array{surveyor: Surveyor|null, barge_id: string|null, denied: bool}
     */
    public static function resolve(User $user): array
    {
        // Privileged roles have unrestricted access.
        if ($user->type->isPrivileged()) {
            return [
                'surveyor' => null,
                'barge_id' => null,
                'denied' => false,
            ];
        }

        // Must be a surveyor-type user.
        if ($user->type->value !== 'surveyor') {
            return [
                'surveyor' => null,
                'barge_id' => null,
                'denied' => true,
            ];
        }

        $surveyor = $user->surveyor;

        // Surveyor user with no linked profile or no barge assigned.
        if (! $surveyor || ! $surveyor->barge_id) {
            return [
                'surveyor' => $surveyor,
                'barge_id' => null,
                'denied' => true,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'surveyor' => $surveyor,
            'barge_id' => $surveyor->barge_id,
            'denied' => false,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Authorize that an order belongs to the surveyor's assigned barge.
     * Privileged users always pass. Aborts 403 on failure.
     */
    public static function authorizeOrder(User $user, string $orderBargeId): void
    {
        $assignment = static::resolve($user);

        if ($assignment['denied']) {
            abort(403);
        }

        // Privileged users can access any barge.
        if ($assignment['barge_id'] === null && $user->type->isPrivileged()) {
            return;
        }

        if ($orderBargeId !== $assignment['barge_id']) {
            abort(403);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Authorize that a BDN barge operation targets the surveyor's assigned barge.
     * Also rejects attempts to change the barge_id away from the assignment.
     */
    public static function authorizeBdnBarge(User $user, string $bargeId, ?string $inputBargeId = null): void
    {
        $assignment = static::resolve($user);

        if ($assignment['denied']) {
            abort(403);
        }

        // Privileged users can manage any barge.
        if ($assignment['barge_id'] === null && $user->type->isPrivileged()) {
            return;
        }

        // If input is trying to change the barge, reject it.
        if ($inputBargeId !== null && $inputBargeId !== $assignment['barge_id']) {
            abort(403);
        }

        // The current barge must match the assignment.
        if ($bargeId !== $assignment['barge_id']) {
            abort(403);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Enums\DeliveryMode;
use App\Enums\FuelGrade;
use App\Enums\Sampling;
use App\Enums\SamplingMethod;
use App\Enums\SupplyLocation;
use App\Models\Agent;
use App\Models\Barge;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\OrderService;
use App\Services\SurveyorAssignment;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

class SurveyingController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = $request->user();
        $assignment = SurveyorAssignment::resolve($user);

        // Surveyor users: force barge from assignment, ignore query param.
        if ($user->type->value === 'surveyor') {
            if ($assignment['denied']) {
                return Inertia::render('surveyor/dashboard', [
                    'pendingOrders' => [],
                    'completedOrders' => [],
                    'barges' => [],
                    'agents' => fn () => Agent::orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name', 'address']),
                    'supplyLocationOptions' => $this->enumOptions(SupplyLocation::cases()),
                    'deliveryMethodOptions' => $this->enumOptions(DeliveryMode::cases()),
                    'samplingLocationOptions' => $this->enumOptions(Sampling::cases()),
                    'samplingMethodOptions' => $this->enumOptions(SamplingMethod::cases()),
                    'assignedBarge' => null,
                ]);
            }

            $barge = $assignment['barge_id'];
            $assignedBarge = Barge::where('imo', $barge)->first(['imo', 'name']);
        } else {
            // Privileged users: use query param as before.
            $barge = $request->query('barge');
            $assignedBarge = null;
        }

        $pendingOrders = fn (): array => $barge
            ? OrderService::pending(dueWithinDays: 3)
                ->where('barge_id', $barge)
                ->load('bdn')
                ->map(fn (Order $order): array => [
                    'id' => $order->id,
                    'order_number' => $order->order_number,
                    'vessel_name' => $order->vessel_name,
                    'vessel_id' => $order->vessel_id,
                    'port' => $order->port?->name,
                    'location' => $order->delivery_location?->label(),
                    'delivery_location' => $order->delivery_location?->value,
                    'delivery_mode' => $order->delivery_mode?->value,
                    'barge_id' => $order->barge_id,
                    'agent_id' => $order->agent_id,
                    'vlsfo_qty' => $order->vlsfo_final_qty,
                    'mgo_qty' => $order->mgo_final_qty,
                    'hsfo_qty' => $order->hsfo_final_qty,
                    'vlsfo_bdn_qty' => $order->vlsfo_bdn_qty,
                    'mgo_bdn_qty' => $order->mgo_bdn_qty,
                    'hsfo_bdn_qty' => $order->hsfo_bdn_qty,
                    'grades' => $this->orderedGrades($order),
                    'bdn' => $order->bdn,
                    'eta' => $order->eta,
                ])
                ->values()
                ->all()
            : [];

        $completedOrders = fn (): array => $barge
            ? OrderService::completedWithin()
                ->where('barge_id', $barge)
                ->flatMap(fn (Order $order): array => collect(FuelGrade::cases())
                    ->map(fn (FuelGrade $grade): array => [
                        'id' => "{$order->id}-{$grade->value}",
                        'order_id' => $order->id,
                        'vessel_name' => $order->vessel_name,
                        'port' => $order->port?->name,
                        'location' => $order->delivery_location?->label(),
                        'product' => $grade->label(),
                        'qty' => $order->{"{$grade->value}_bdn_qty"} ?? $order->{"{$grade->value}_final_qty"},
                        'eta' => $order->eta,
                    ])
                    ->filter(fn (array $row): bool => filled($row['qty']))
                    ->values()
                    ->all())
                ->values()
                ->all()
            : [];

        // Barges: surveyor sees only their assigned barge.
        $barges = $user->type->value === 'surveyor' && $assignedBarge
            ? fn () => collect([$assignedBarge])
            : fn () => Barge::orderBy('name')->get(['imo', 'name']);

        return Inertia::render('surveyor/dashboard', [
            'pendingOrders' => $pendingOrders,
            'completedOrders' => $completedOrders,
            'barges' => $barges,
            'agents' => fn () => Agent::orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name', 'address']),
            'supplyLocationOptions' => $this->enumOptions(SupplyLocation::cases()),
            'deliveryMethodOptions' => $this->enumOptions(DeliveryMode::cases()),
            'samplingLocationOptions' => $this->enumOptions(Sampling::cases()),
            'samplingMethodOptions' => $this->enumOptions(SamplingMethod::cases()),
            'assignedBarge' => $assignedBarge,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * The fuel grades this order actually covers, so the BDN dialog only
     * renders the blocks the surveyor has to fill in.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{value: string, label: string}>
     */
    private function orderedGrades(Order $order): array
    {
        return collect(FuelGrade::cases())
            ->filter(fn (FuelGrade $grade): bool => filled($order->{"{$grade->value}_final_qty"})
                || filled($order->{"{$grade->value}_quantity_high"})
                || filled($order->{"{$grade->value}_quantity_low"}))

            'bdn' => $bdn,
            'deliveryLocationLabel' => $bdn?->delivery_location?->label(),
            'deliveryMethodLabel' => $bdn?->delivery_method !== null
                ? Str::headline($bdn->delivery_method->name)
                : null,
        ])
            ->format('a4')
            ->margins(20, 12, 20, 12)
            ->name("eBDN-{$order->order_number}.pdf");
    }

    /**
     * Upsert the order's Bunker Delivery Note. No flash toast: the surveyor
     * dialog autosaves, and its own status line reports the result.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, Order $order): RedirectResponse
    {
        SurveyorAssignment::authorizeBdnBarge(
            $request->user(),
            $order->barge_id,
            $request->input('barge_id'),

            $validated['barge_id'] = $assignment['barge_id'];

            ['order_id' => $order->id],
            [...$validated, 'bdn_number' => $order->bdn()->value('bdn_number') ?? "BDN-{$order->order_number}"],

     * little of the note has been filled in so far.

    private function rules(): array
    {
        $rules = [
            'delivery_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'delivery_location' => ['nullable', Rule::enum(SupplyLocation::class)],
            'vessel_flag' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],

        foreach (FuelGrade::keys() as $grade) {
            foreach (Bdn::TIMESHEET_FIELDS as $field) {

            }

            foreach (array_keys(Bdn::QUALITY_FIELDS) as $field) {

            $rules["{$sample}_seal_number"] = ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'];
            $rules["{$sample}_counter_seal_number"] = ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'];

    public const SAMPLE_TYPES = ['marpol', 'vessel', 'barge', 'retention'];

    /**
     * Quality and quantity columns, per grade, mapped to their decimal scale.
     *
     * @var array<string, int>
     */
    public const QUALITY_FIELDS = [
        'density_15' => 4,
        'sulphur_pct' => 3,
        'viscosity_50' => 1,
        'flash_point' => 1,
        'kilo_liter' => 3,
        'metric_ton' => 3,
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        $casts = [
            'delivery_date' => 'date',
            'delivery_location' => SupplyLocation::class,
            'grt' => 'decimal:2',
            'delivery_method' => DeliveryMode::class,
            // Wall-clock format so the datetime-local inputs round-trip unshifted.
            'barge_alongside_at' => 'datetime:Y-m-d\TH:i',
            'chief_engineer_invited' => 'boolean',
            'chief_engineer_witnessed' => 'boolean',
            'retained_samples_handed_over' => 'boolean',
            'sampling_location' => Sampling::class,
            'sampling_method' => SamplingMethod::class,
        ];

        foreach (FuelGrade::keys() as $grade) {
            foreach (self::TIMESHEET_FIELDS as $field) {
                $casts["{$grade}_{$field}"] = 'datetime:Y-m-d\TH:i';
            }

            foreach (self::QUALITY_FIELDS as $field => $scale) {
                $casts["{$grade}_{$field}"] = "decimal:{$scale}";
            }
        }

        return $casts;
    }

    /** @return BelongsTo<Order, $this> */
    public function order(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Order::class);
    }

    /** @return BelongsTo<Agent, $this> */
    public function agent(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Agent::class);
    }

    /** @return BelongsTo<Barge, $this> */
    public function barge(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Barge::class, 'barge_id');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Enums\FuelGrade;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Agent;
use App\Models\AgentPic;
use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

class OrderService
{
    /**
     * Pending orders for the port-grouped dashboards, customer + port loaded.
     *
     * $dueWithinDays caps the list at orders whose ETA falls within that many
     * days. There is no lower bound, so overdue orders — and orders with no ETA
     * yet — stay on the list rather than disappearing from it.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    public static function pending(?int $dueWithinDays = null): Collection
    {
        return Order::with(['customer', 'port'])
            ->whereIn('status', OrderStatus::pendingStatuses())
            ->when($dueWithinDays !== null, fn ($query) => $query->where(
                fn ($due) => $due->whereNull('eta')
                    ->orWhere('eta', '<=', Carbon::today()->addDays($dueWithinDays)->endOfDay()),
            ))
            ->orderBy('port_id')
            ->orderBy('eta')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * Orders completed within the last $days, same loading and ordering.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    public static function completedWithin(int $days = 30): Collection
    {
        return Order::with(['customer', 'port'])
            ->whereIn('status', OrderStatus::completedStatuses())
            ->where('invoice_date', '>=', Carbon::now()->subDays($days))
            ->orderBy('port_id')
            ->orderBy('eta')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * Mark an order delivered and stamp its invoice: value is the sum of each
     * grade's BDN quantity times its rate, due date is today plus credit terms.
     */
    public static function complete(Order $order): void
    {
        $invoiceDate = Carbon::today();

        $order->update([
            'status' => OrderStatus::Delivered,
            'invoice_date' => $invoiceDate,
            'invoice_value' => self::invoiceValue($order),
            'payment_due_date' => $invoiceDate->copy()->addDays($order->credit_terms?->days() ?? 0),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Recompute a delivered order's invoice value after a rate or BDN quantity
     * correction. A no-op outside Delivered: pending orders have no invoice yet,
     * and closed orders are settled — repricing one would retroactively break
     * isPaidInFull().
     */
    public static function reprice(Order $order): void
    {
        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::Delivered) {
            return;
        }

        $order->update(['invoice_value' => self::invoiceValue($order)]);
    }

    /**
     * Sum of each grade's BDN quantity times its rate.
     */
    private static function invoiceValue(Order $order): float
    {
        return collect(FuelGrade::keys())->sum(
            fn (string $product): float => (float) $order->{"{$product}_bdn_qty"} * (float) $order->{"{$product}_rate"},
        );
    }

    /**
     * The columns every order dashboard shows.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function toRow(Order $order): array
    {
        $row = [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'order_number' => $order->order_number,
            'customer_name' => $order->customer?->name,
            'vessel_name' => $order->vessel_name,
            'vessel_id' => $order->vessel_id,
            'port' => $order->port?->name,
            'vlsfo_qty' => $order->vlsfo_final_qty ?? $order->vlsfo_qty_range,
            'mgo_qty' => $order->mgo_final_qty ?? $order->mgo_qty_range,
            'hsfo_qty' => $order->hsfo_final_qty ?? $order->hsfo_qty_range,
            'vlsfo_final_qty' => $order->vlsfo_final_qty,
            'mgo_final_qty' => $order->mgo_final_qty,
            'hsfo_final_qty' => $order->hsfo_final_qty,
            'agent_id' => $order->agent_id,
            'agent_name' => $order->agent_name,
            'agent_pic_id' => $order->agent_pic_id,
            'pic' => $order->pic,
            'mobile_no' => $order->mobile_no,
            'eta' => $order->eta,
            'laycan_from' => $order->laycan_from,
            'status' => $order->status->value,
        ];

        foreach (FuelGrade::keys() as $grade) {
            $row["{$grade}_quantity_low"] = $order->{"{$grade}_quantity_low"};
            $row["{$grade}_quantity_high"] = $order->{"{$grade}_quantity_high"};
        }

        return $row;
    }

    /**
     * Copy the agency and PIC names onto the order so a later rename of either
     * record leaves it alone. Only touches a name when its id was submitted.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $validated
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function withAgentSnapshot(array $validated): array
    {
        if (array_key_exists('agent_id', $validated)) {
            $validated['agent_name'] = Agent::find($validated['agent_id'])?->name;
        }

        if (array_key_exists('agent_pic_id', $validated)) {
            $validated['pic'] = AgentPic::find($validated['agent_pic_id'])?->name;
        }

        return $validated;
    }

    /**
     * Format a low/high quantity pair into the range string shown on dashboards.
     * Falls back to the single bound when only one side is set.
     */
    public static function formatQtyRange(?float $low, ?float $high): ?string
    {
        if ($low !== null && $high !== null) {
            return "{$low} - {$high}";
        }

        $single = $low ?? $high;

        return $single === null ? null : (string) $single;
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Agent;

use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Exists;

abstract class Controller
{
    /**
     * Redirect back with a flash toast (see HandleInertiaRequests + useFlashToast).
     */
    protected function toast(string $message, string $type = 'success'): RedirectResponse
    {
        return back()->with('toast', ['type' => $type, 'message' => $message]);
    }

    /**
     * Map backed-enum cases to headline-cased select options.
     *
     * @param  array<int, \BackedEnum>  $cases
     * @return array<int, array{value: string, label: string}>
     */
    protected function enumOptions(array $cases): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (\BackedEnum $case) => [
            'value' => (string) $case->value,
            'label' => method_exists($case, 'label') ? $case->label() : Str::headline($case->name),
        ], $cases);
    }

    /**
     * Agency and PIC lists backing the shared <AgentContactFields> trio.
     * Column lists mirror AgentOption / AgentPicOption in resources/js/types/ui.ts.
     *
     * @return array<string, Collection<int, Model>>
     */
    protected function agentContactProps(): array
    {
        return [
            'agents' => Agent::orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name', 'address']),
            'agentPics' => AgentPic::orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'agent_id', 'name', 'mobile']),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Accept a PIC only when it belongs to the agency submitted alongside it,
     * so an order can never snapshot a mismatched agency/PIC pair.
     */
    protected function agentPicRule(Request $request): Exists
    {
        return Rule::exists('agent_pics', 'id')->where('agent_id', $request->input('agent_id'));
    }

    /**
     * The label of the first reference that still has rows, or null when none do.
     * Use before deleting a record other tables have a foreign key to, so the
     * constraint violation becomes a toast instead of a 500.
     *
     * @param  array<string, \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<*>>  $references
     */
    protected function inUseBy(array $references): ?string
    {
        foreach ($references as $label => $query) {
            if ($query->exists()) {
                return $label;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Delete a record unless another table still references it, either way
     * reporting the outcome as a toast. `$noun` names the record in both
     * messages, e.g. 'Customer'.
     *
     * @param  array<string, \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<*>>  $references
     */
    protected function deleteGuarded(Model $model, string $noun, array $references): RedirectResponse
    {
        $inUseBy = $this->inUseBy($references);

        if ($inUseBy !== null) {
            return $this->toast(
                'Cannot delete this '.Str::lower($noun).": it is still referenced by {$inUseBy}.",
                'error',
            );
        }

        $model->delete();

        return $this->toast("{$noun} deleted.");
    }
}

/**
 * Create a surveyor-type user, optionally with a linked Surveyor profile and assigned barge.
 */
function makeSurveyorUser(?string $bargeImo = null): User
{
    $user = User::factory()->create(['type' => UserType::Surveyor]);

    if ($bargeImo !== null) {
        Surveyor::factory()->create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'barge_id' => $bargeImo,
        ]);
    }

    return $user;
}

/**
 * Create a pending order on a specific barge with a VLSFO BDN quantity ready.
 */
function makeOrderOnBarge(string $bargeImo, array $attributes = []): Order
{
    return Order::factory()->create(array_merge([
        'barge_id' => $bargeImo,
        'status' => OrderStatus::Pending,
        'eta' => now(),
        'vlsfo_final_qty' => 100,
    ], $attributes));
}

    expect($surveyor->user_id)->toBe($user->id);
    expect($surveyor->user)->not->toBeNull();
    expect($surveyor->user->id)->toBe($user->id);

    expect($user->surveyor->id)->toBe($surveyor->id);
